advice: Strict sun protection, including indoor light near windows. Use umbrella and cap. Do not use steroid creams on face on your own. Melasma tends to recur.
name: Melasma

rx.instr: (rule out history of clotting, smoking, OCP use)
Apply thin layer on patches at night max, then stop

rx.sig: Apply every morning and reapply every 3 hours

rx.instr: Maintenance: apply twice daily after stopping triple combination
